    15	| E4 (get_tokens) | _(none)_ | `/v2/users/<int:uid>/tokens` | **NO shim** | Security fix: v1 returned tokens without auth check; v2 requires Bearer token |
    16	| E5 (legacy_export) | `/v1/users/legacy_export` | `/v2/users/export` | **REMOVE shim** | All clients migrated to /v2/users/export by 2025-Q1 |
